dedupe_keys.name: deliverable 2 3 supplementary material model input files for the danube catchment modelling

description: van Gils, Jos and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The package provides DELWAQ input and batch-file descriptors, substance-specific information, wflow catchment schematisation and hydrological results used in emission and water-quality calculation stages. It supports the PROMISCES Danube fate-and-transport model train. Model inputs and generated hydrological fields are distinct from the separately observed PFAS concentrations. The metadata identify grouped files but do not establish complete variable lists, temporal resolution or equal coverage for every substance. No archive was opened or calculation executed, and an input package is not treated as a new general-purpose solver. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
